_readme: Shown as a small card on Ascend's Home screen (app 1.0.2+). Checked once a day. One card at a time, in order; users can dismiss each by id. Fields: id (unique, never reuse), title, body, optional button + url (https:// or market://, opens in the browser/Play Store), optional onlyBelow (e.g. "1.0.3" = only show to versions older than that), optional expires ("YYYY-MM-DD", hidden from that day).
